show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Jason Karp – From Hedge Funds to Health and Wellness at HumanCo (First Meeting, EP.12)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

key_points.text: Human Co, a mission-driven, disruptive holding company focused on investing in healthier living.

key_points.text: Before diving into this endeavor, Jason had a very successful 20-year career in the hedge fund industry.
key_points.evidence_quote: Before diving into this endeavor, Jason had a very successful 20-year career in the hedge fund industry, culminating in a six-year run as founder of Turbion Capital.

thesis: The speaker argues that while the hedge fund industry became an arms race reliant on faster machines and connections, his personal strength lay in human judgment balanced with emotional discipline. He emphasizes that good decision-making requires a repeatable process driven by checklists and behavioral finance principles to avoid cognitive biases, rather than relying on memory or innate intelligence.
